title: Show HN: Isopolis – Isometric pixel map of SF
summary: Isopolis is an interactive isometric pixel art map of San Francisco that allows users to explore the city's geography and landmarks in a retro gaming aesthetic. The project showcases SF's neighborhoods, streets, and notable locations rendered in charming pixel art style with smooth isometric perspective.
problem_solved: Provides an engaging, visually nostalgic way to explore and navigate San Francisco's urban geography through interactive pixel art.
why_valuable: Combines creative artistic expression with geographic visualization, offering a unique perspective on the city that appeals to both locals and visitors while demonstrating impressive technical and artistic skill.
